title: Comtura 4 TR
notes: Official page read 2026-11-01: high-end racing model of the Comtura TR range for road and gravel; tubeless; Vectran puncture layer; TPI 210/375; 'fully compatible with hookless rims'. 700x25C 260 g, 7 bar (100 psi); 28C 280 g, 6 bar (90 psi); 30C 300 g, 5.5 bar (80 psi); EUR 57.90 each.
